cadence.proof: UT_accmetabolism.lua:15 registers only Events.EveryTenMinutes.Add(handler). GameTime.java:729-734 invokes Erosion/Climate/room-light updates, then LuaEventManager.triggerEvent("EveryTenMinutes") with zero arguments, then updates minutesMod; the handler is therefore ordered after those three engine updates and before minutesMod assignment/radio update on each ten-minute boundary.
cadence.positive_path: When GameTime reaches a new ten-minute bucket, triggerEvent dispatches the registered zero-argument handler once in the event listener sequence.
cadence.negative_path: A one-minute boundary that is not also a ten-minute boundary only triggers EveryOneMinute at GameTime.java:737-739 and has no registration in this trait module.

cooldown.proof: UT_accmetabolism.lua:4-15 defines only TRAIT_ID and the handler closure; it has no timestamp, counter, modData key, elapsed-time read, or conditional cooldown. EveryTenMinutes is the sole limiter.

cooldown.negative_path: Without an EveryTenMinutes dispatch, elapsed wall time, ticks, or world age cannot invoke this module because none is read or subscribed.
